analysis.headline: Defensive Health Care and Tech Niche Leadership Persists While Selective Emerging Cyclicals Gain Traction
analysis.executive_summary: Cross-sectional rotation reflects persistent relative strength in select thematic leadership alongside emerging cyclical improvements in Industrials and Materials, while broad Communication Services and Real Estate remain pressured. Confirmed 3-observation trend states show Health Care (XLV score 89.0) and Cloud Computing (SKYY score 83.33) retaining high rotation scores, while Aerospace & Defense (ITA score 71.46) and Metals & Mining (XME score 64.38) exhibit strong 20-bar score expansion (+42.75 and +44.75 points respectively). Notable within-sector divergences are present in Industrials, Communication Services, Financials, and Consumer Discretionary.

emerging_rotations.explanation: ITA holds a confirmed EMERGING state with a rotation score of 71.46, driven by a 20-bar score improvement of 42.75 points and a 5-bar score gain of 9.98 points. Relative strength vs SPY is positive across both horizons at +7.20 percentage points over 20 bars and +10.41 percentage points over 63 bars.

risks_or_conflicts: Sector Divergence in Industrials: Aerospace & Defense (ITA score_change_20: +42.75, score: 71.46) is improving significantly, whereas Transportation (IYT score_change_20: -25.19, score: 25.00) is severely deteriorating.

Sector Divergence in Communication Services: Telecommunications (IYZ score_change_20: +32.57) is improving, while Global Communication Services (IXP score_change_20: -26.25) and XLC (score: 17.00) remain in ROTATION_OUT.
Sector Divergence in Financials: Financial Services (IYG score_change_20: +25.79) is advancing, while Insurance (KIE score_change_20: -19.72) and Banks (KBE score: 48.96) reflect relative weakening.

Sector Divergence in Consumer Discretionary: Homebuilders (XHB score_change_20: +21.11) show positive score changes, whereas Retail (XRT score_change_20: -23.61) and Consumer Discretionary (XLY score: 25.00) suffer rotation out.

Pair State Tension in Style Factors: IWD holds a confirmed trend state of WEAKENING (20-bar score change -19.21) while simultaneously holding a confirmed PAIR_LEADING signal versus paired_ticker IWF due to its strong 63-bar spread (+10.22 percentage points), despite a negative 20-bar spread (-0.78 percentage points) and pending PAIR_MIXED raw condition.
analysis.methodology_note: Interpretation uses Python-confirmed trend states that require 3 consecutive daily observations before a new raw condition becomes canonical. Raw conditions remain available as pending early warnings. Evidence also uses deterministic 5-bar score changes, 20- and 63-bar relative strength or pair spreads, persistence metrics, and Python-calculated attention flags including 63-bar rotation-score extrema and material cross-market conflicts. ETF volume and CMF are treated as market-participation indicators, not fund-flow data.
